sources.description: Enterprise births x CAE x municipality (NUTS2013 geocods)
Enterprise births x CAE x municipality (NUTS2024 geocods)

note_acores: Açores geocods appear to use a different prefix (not starting with 4 in 2020 probe — may use 48xxxx or Açores-specific prefix). Exact count from geocod prefix analysis: acores=0 in probe due to prefix assumption. Açores may use different prefix. Total=308 confirmed including all autonomous regions.
kz_absence_reason: INE definitionally excludes section K (finance/insurance) from enterprise births per DEC-018 INE 0009703 audit. Consistent with Eurostat/OECD enterprise demography convention.
a10_note: Section A (agriculture) maps to OQ/A depending on observatory convention. Section T/U negligible (not reported by INE 0009703). 8 of 9 HERALD A10 sectors mappable; KZ (finance) absent.
nuts_break: NUTS2013 geocods (0009703) valid through 2022. NUTS2024 geocods (0014099) from 2023. Geocod format change: 7-character codes may shift between NUTS versions. Requires alignment for panel 2008-2023.
geocod_stability: Municipality codes (concelhos) are generally stable. Some boundary adjustments may affect geocod consistency over 16 years. INE maintains concordance tables.
continental_filter: Feasible via geocod prefix. Continental geocods confirmed: 297 in probe. Madeira: 11. Açores: ~19 (prefix clarification needed). Total continente: ~278.
risks: KZ sector missing (by definition) — cannot test KZ-related HERALD relations at municipal level
NUTS2013/NUTS2024 geocod break at 2022/2023 transition requires explicit alignment
Açores geocod prefix assumption needs verification
Statistical disclosure control: some small municipalities may have suppressed cells
Municipal boundary changes over 2008-2023 may affect geocod stability
Section A (agriculture) mapping: INE includes it, HERALD OQ convention differs
